title: 污泥帶濾式脫水
summary: 本課以重力排水、楔形壓榨與帶面負荷為主線，從進料乾固體、調理與藥劑活性、重力排水接觸、帶寬固體負荷進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。
summaryEn: This course develops gravity drainage, wedge pressing and belt loading through ten connected units, beginning with feed dry solids, conditioning and active polymer, gravity-drainage contact, solids per belt width. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 進料乾固體：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Feed dry solids: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 進料乾固體 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Feed dry solids and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 液體與固體流量都要量，才能計算每米帶寬承受的負荷。
steps.instructionEn: Measure liquid and solids flow before evaluating load per belt width.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：污泥 Q=50 m³/d；ρ=1000 kg/m³；TS=0.04。模型 MDS=QρTS，代入得到 2000 kg DS/d。適用邊界：TS 是濕基質量分率，密度在本例近似水。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Sludge Q=50 m³/d; density=1000 kg/m³; TS=0.04. Model MDS=QρTS gives 2000 kg DS/d. Applicability: TS is a wet-basis mass fraction; density is approximated as water.
steps.failure: 低濃度大流量淹沒重力段。診斷與介入：用代表性含固樣本重算乾量，避免濕重混用。
steps.failureEn: Large dilute flow floods the gravity zone. Diagnostic response: Recalculate dry mass from representative solids samples, without mixing wet mass.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「進料乾固體」的觀測點。由體積、密度與烘乾固體三個獨立量測建質量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
steps.checkEn: In the offline workbench, select the observation point for feed dry solids. Build mass from independent volume, density and oven-dry solids measurements. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只改變 TS:0.04→0.05，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2000 變為 2500 kg DS/d。用「進料乾固體」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。
knowledge.textEn: Change only TS:0.04→0.05, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2000 to 2500 kg DS/d. Explain the direction using feed dry solids, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「污泥帶濾式脫水」的「進料乾固體：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「再生水品質交班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Feed dry solids: Mechanism and observation” in “Belt-filter sludge dewatering”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Water-reuse quality handover” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 調理與藥劑活性：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Conditioning and active polymer: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 調理與藥劑活性 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Conditioning and active polymer and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 聚合物促進絮凝與自由水釋出，效果取決於污泥而非固定通用劑量。
steps.instructionEn: Polymer promotes flocculation and free-water release; performance depends on sludge, not a universal dose.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設：DS=2000 kg/d；假設用量=4 kg active/t DS。模型 Mpoly=MDS D/1000，代入得到 8 kg active/d。適用邊界：只示範乾基換算；最佳用量須由污泥試驗判定。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions: DS=2000 kg/d; assumed dose=4 kg active/t DS. Model Mpoly=MDS D/1000 gives 8 kg active/d. Applicability: Dry-basis conversion only; appropriate dose requires sludge testing.
steps.failure: 過量聚合物可能黏帶而非改善排水。診斷與介入：校核有效聚合物乾基，將藥耗與泥餅及濾液表現比較。
steps.failureEn: Excess polymer can blind the belt instead of improving drainage. Diagnostic response: Check active polymer on a dry-solids basis and compare consumption with cake/filtrate performance.
steps.check: 在離線工作台先選取「調理與藥劑活性」的觀測點。把稀釋藥液量還原成活性聚合物，觀察絮體與濾液。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。
